    jmt latest API

    Packages
    Package
    Description
    analytical
    Analytical JMVA model layer: constants, parameters and the model data structure of the alphanumeric MVA solver, as described in the JMVA chapter of the user manual.
    common
    Shared GUI framework of JMT: the common model definition, editors, strategies and panels used by the JSIMgraph and JSIMwiz tools to define simulation models.
    common.animation
    Animation framework shared by the JMT graphical tools to visualize queueing stations and their state during simulation.
    common.cacheSimulation
    GUI support for configuring the cache simulation features of the JSIM engine.
    common.classSwitchUtilities
    GUI utilities for the class switch feature of JSIM, which lets jobs change their customer class during the simulation.
    common.controller
    Controllers of the shared JMT GUI model layer, including the model checker that validates a model before its simulation is started.
    common.definitions
    Definition of the JMT simulation model data structure (CommonModel, StationDefinition, ClassDefinition, ...) shared by JSIMgraph and JSIMwiz.
    common.definitions.convertors
    Converters of the JMT model definitions.
    common.definitions.parametric
    What-if (parametric) analysis definitions of the JMT GUI layer: parametric model modifiers and their checking logic, as described in the JSIM chapters of the user manual.
    common.distributions
    Editors and descriptors of the probability distributions that characterize service and inter-arrival times in the JMT GUI tools.
    common.distributions.discrete
    Discrete distribution descriptors and editors for the JMT GUI tools.
    common.editors
    Swing cell editors used by the JMT GUI tables to edit model parameters.
    common.forkStrategies
    GUI wrappers for the JSIM fork strategies used at fork stations.
    common.joinStrategies
    GUI wrappers for the JSIM join strategies used at join stations.
    common.panels
    Panels of the JMT simulation model wizards: source, sink, queue, delay, fork, join, router, logger, class switch and related parameter panels used by JSIMgraph and JSIMwiz.
    common.panels.parametric
    Panels of the what-if (parametric) analysis configuration dialogs of the JMT GUI tools.
    common.routingStrategies
    GUI wrappers for the JSIM routing strategies (Markovian, round robin, shortest queue, ...) available at router stations.
    common.semaphoreStrategies
    GUI wrappers for the JSIM semaphore strategies.
    common.serviceStrategies
    GUI wrappers for the JSIM service time strategies, including load dependent service.
    common.startScreen
    The JMT suite starting screen used to select the application to be executed, as described in the introduction of the user manual.
    common.startScreen.sampleAnimation
    Sample animation shown on the JMT starting screen.
    common.transitionUtilities
    GUI utilities for the place-transition (Petri net) structures of JSIM.
    common.xml
    XML reading and writing of the JMT model file format, the XML data layer that enables full reusability of the computational engines.
    dataAnalysis
    Output analysis of JSIM simulation results.
    dataAnalysis.measureOutputs
    Output writers for simulation measures, including the CSV output formats consumed by the JMT loggers.
    dataAnalysis.sorting
    Sorting algorithms used internally by the data analyzers of the JSIM engine.
    exactModelUtils
    Utilities for the exact solution of product form queueing networks in JMVA.
    graphic
    Low level graphic mathematics used by the JMT visualization layers (vectors, matrices and projection utilities).
    jaba
    The JABA tool: identification of bottlenecks in multiclass closed product form networks using efficient convex hull algorithms, as described in the user manual.
    jaba.cartesian
    Cartesian plane drawing support of the JABA graphical interface.
    jaba.convexHull3d
    Three dimensional convex hull algorithms used by JABA for models with three customer classes.
    jaba.convexHull3d.exceptions
    Exceptions raised by the JABA three dimensional convex hull algorithms.
    jaba.graphs
    Graphical components of JABA: two and three dimensional graphs of the saturation sectors and of the convex hull of the model.
    jaba.Hull
    Two dimensional convex hull algorithms used by JABA to build the characteristic polytope of the model.
    jaba.label
    Label components of the JABA graphical interface.
    jaba.link
    Link component of the JABA graphical interface.
    jaba.panels
    Panels of the JABA wizard: Classes, Stations, Service Times, Performance Indices, Sectors and Convex Hull views described in the JABA chapter of the user manual.
    jmt.commandline
    Command line interface of the JMT suite.
    jmt.common
    Common classes shared by the JMT engine, including network constants, common exceptions and XML element definitions.
    jmt.common.exception
    Exceptions shared by the JMT engine, such as the load exception raised when a closed workload exceeds the capacity of the network.
    jmt.common.xml
    XML constants for the JMT model file format, shared between the engine and the file handling layer.
    jmt.framework.data
    Data handling utilities of the JMT framework (array manipulation, structured lists and matrix helpers).
    jmt.framework.gui
    Reusable GUI framework of JMT: general purpose Swing components, controllers and helpers shared by the JMT tools.
    jmt.framework.gui.components
    General purpose Swing components of the JMT GUI framework (buttons, panels, text areas, ...).
    jmt.framework.gui.controller
    Controller support of the JMT GUI framework (undo/redo and action management).
    jmt.framework.gui.graph
    Fast lightweight graph components of the JMT GUI framework, used to plot simulation results on line.
    jmt.framework.gui.help
    Help support of the JMT GUI framework.
    jmt.framework.gui.image
    Image support of the JMT GUI framework (icons and image painters).
    jmt.framework.gui.layouts
    Custom layout managers of the JMT GUI framework.
    jmt.framework.gui.listeners
    Listener interfaces and adapters of the JMT GUI framework.
    jmt.framework.gui.table.editors
    Cell editors of the JMT table framework.
    jmt.framework.gui.wizard
    Wizard framework of the JMT GUI tools: window infrastructure used to build the step by step model definition wizards.
    jmt.framework.net
    Network support of the JMT framework.
    jmt.framework.xml
    XML utilities of the JMT framework layer.
    jmt.jmarkov
    Markov chain engine of the JMCH tool: computation of the steady state distribution of the Markov chains underlying the modeled queueing stations.
    jmt.jmarkov.Graphics
    Graphics of the JMCH Markov chain visualization.
    jmt.jmarkov.Graphics.constants
    Constants of the JMCH Markov chain graphics.
    jmt.jmarkov.Queues
    Markov chain queueing models of JMCH: M/M/1, M/M/1/k, M/M/c and M/M/c/k stations, as described in the JMCH chapter of the user manual.
    jmt.jmarkov.Queues.Exceptions
    Exceptions raised by the JMCH Markov chain queueing models.
    jmt.jmarkov.utils
    Utilities of the JMCH Markov chain engine.
    jmt.jmch
    The JMCH tool: a modelling classroom helper that applies a simulation technique to solve single station models, as described in the user manual.
    jmt.jmch.animation
    Animation of the JMCH tool: animated queues, routers, stations and edges used to visualize the scheduling and routing algorithms during their execution.
    jmt.jmch.animation.customQueue
    Custom queue graphics of the JMCH animation.
    jmt.jmch.animation.solver
    Solver of the JMCH animation (event scheduling of the animated simulation).
    jmt.jmch.distributions
    Distribution support of the JMCH wizard.
    jmt.jmch.simulation
    Simulation engine of JMCH: single station simulation of the scheduling algorithms and network simulation of the routing algorithms.
    jmt.jmch.wizard
    Wizard of the JMCH tool: step by step definition of the station or network to be simulated.
    jmt.jmch.wizard.actionsWizard
    Actions of the JMCH wizard panels.
    jmt.jmch.wizard.panels
    Panels of the JMCH wizard.
    jmt.jmch.wizard.panels.markovPanel
    Markov chain panel of the JMCH wizard, which shows the states of the Markov chain generated by the modeled queueing station.
    jmt.jmch.wizard.panels.resultsPanel
    Results panel of the JMCH wizard.
    jmt.manual
    Browser for the JMT documentation shipped with the suite.
    jmva
    JMVA application entry point: the wizard based alphanumeric MVA solver of JMT.
    jmva.engine
    Dispatcher of the JMVA GUI: it collects the model from the panels, runs the selected solution algorithm and returns the results for display.
    jmva.eval
    Expression evaluator of the JMVA wizard, used to enter service times and demands as expressions of model parameters.
    jmva.link
    Link between the JMVA GUI and the model data structures of the JSIM graph editor.
    jmva.panels
    Panels of the JMVA wizard: Classes, Stations, Service Times, Service Demands, Visits, Reference Stations, What-if and Comment tabs, as described in the JMVA chapter of the user manual.
    jmva.utilities
    Utilities of the JMVA GUI.
    jsimgraph
    The JSIMgraph tool: the graphical user friendly interface for the JSIM simulation engine, as described in the user manual.
    jsimgraph.controller
    Controllers of JSIMgraph: the mediator between the graph editor and the simulation model, and the simulation state checker.
    jsimgraph.controller.actions
    Actions of the JSIMgraph editor: menu and toolbar commands to create stations, connections and to run the simulations.
    jsimgraph.definitions
    Definition interfaces of the JSIMgraph model data source, shared between the graph editor and the model layer.
    jsimgraph.JGraphMod
    JGraph based graph editor of JSIMgraph: the cells, ports and views used to draw the queueing network topology in the graphical workspace.
    jsimgraph.mainGui
    Main window of the JSIMgraph application.
    jsimgraph.panels
    Panels of the JSIMgraph application.
    jsimgraph.template
    Model templates of JSIMgraph, used to quickly create new simulation models.
    jsimwiz
    JSIMwiz application entry point: the wizard based interface for the JSIM discrete event simulator.
    jsimwiz.definitions
    Definition interfaces of the JSIMwiz textual wizard model layer.
    jsimwiz.panels
    Panels of the JSIMwiz wizard: the textual, step by step interface for the JSIM simulation engine described in the user manual.
    jwat
    The JWAT tool: workload characterization, as described in the user manual.
    jwat.filters
    Filters applied by JWAT to the imported workload data (scaling, sampling, outlier filtering, ...).
    jwat.fitting
    Distribution fitting of the JWAT tool, including the Gulati-Shapiro test for the Pareto distribution.
    jwat.fitting.charts
    Charts of the JWAT distribution fitting panels.
    jwat.fitting.panels
    Panels of the JWAT distribution fitting views.
    jwat.fitting.utils
    Utilities of the JWAT distribution fitting views.
    jwat.input
    Input file formats of JWAT: standard formats such as Apache HTTP and IIS logs, plus user customized formats.
    jwat.trafficAnalysis
    Traffic analysis support of JWAT: aggregation and analysis of arrival data.
    jwat.trafficAnalysis.panels
    Panels of the JWAT traffic analysis views.
    jwat.trafficAnalysis.utils
    Utilities of the JWAT traffic analysis views.
    jwat.workloadAnalysis
    Workload analysis model of JWAT: the observations, variables and parameters of the workload characterization process.
    jwat.workloadAnalysis.chart
    Chart components of the JWAT workload analysis (histograms, boxplots, scatterplots, ...).
    jwat.workloadAnalysis.clustering
    Clustering algorithms of JWAT for identifying similarities in the input data.
    jwat.workloadAnalysis.clustering.fuzzyKMean
    Fuzzy k-means clustering algorithm of JWAT (originally coded in Fortran in 1983 and migrated to Java in 2006).
    jwat.workloadAnalysis.clustering.fuzzyKMean.panels
    Panels of the JWAT fuzzy k-means clustering view.
    jwat.workloadAnalysis.clustering.kMean
    K-means clustering algorithm of JWAT.
    jwat.workloadAnalysis.clustering.kMean.panels
    Panels of the JWAT k-means clustering view.
    jwat.workloadAnalysis.exceptions
    Exceptions raised by the JWAT workload analysis.
    jwat.workloadAnalysis.panels
    Panels of the JWAT workload analysis wizard.
    jwat.workloadAnalysis.tables
    Tables of the JWAT workload analysis views.
    jwat.workloadAnalysis.tables.listeners
    Listeners of the JWAT workload analysis tables.
    jwat.workloadAnalysis.tables.renderers
    Cell renderers of the JWAT workload analysis tables.
    jwat.workloadAnalysis.utils
    Utilities of the JWAT workload analysis (session management, variable listeners, model helpers).
    legacyxml
    Export of JMT models to the XML format of earlier JMT releases (JDK only), for compatibility with legacy model files.
    log
    Logging support used by the JMT engine to trace simulation runs and to write the logger station output files.
    math
    Mathematical library of the JMT engine: special functions (gamma, beta, error function), polynomials, fast Fourier transforms and circular lists used by the spectral transient detection.
    math.parser
    Expression parser and evaluator used by JMT, for example for the expression-based parameters of the JMVA what-if analysis described in the user manual.
    NetStrategies
    Strategy interfaces and base classes used by the JSIM simulation engine to implement the behaviour of the network elements.
    NetStrategies.CacheStrategies
    Cache eviction strategies used by cache-equipped stations to decide which cached item is removed when the cache is full.
    NetStrategies.ForkStrategies
    Strategies used by fork stations to split a job into the output tasks that are then routed to the downstream stations.
    NetStrategies.ImpatienceStrategies
    Impatience strategies that model customers leaving a queue before being served, either by balking (refusing to join the queue) or reneging (abandoning the queue after joining).
    NetStrategies.ImpatienceStrategies.ImpatienceMeasurement
    Support classes that measure and store impatience statistics (balking and reneging) collected during a JSIM simulation run.
    NetStrategies.JoinStrategies
    Strategies used by join stations to synchronize the tasks of a forked job and release the job when its tasks have been recombined.
    NetStrategies.PSStrategies
    Processor sharing service strategies, in which every job present at the station is served simultaneously and the station capacity is shared among the jobs.
    NetStrategies.QueueGetStrategies
    Queue visit strategies that select which job leaves the queue to enter service, implementing scheduling disciplines such as FCFS, LCFS, SJF, LJF and SEPT.
    NetStrategies.QueuePutStrategies
    Queue insertion strategies that select the position in the queue where an arriving job is placed, implementing queueing disciplines such as FCFS and priority-based placement.
    NetStrategies.RoutingStrategies
    Routing strategies used by router nodes to select the destination station of each departing job.
    NetStrategies.SemaphoreStrategies
    Semaphore strategies controlling the release of permits in the place-transition (synchronization) structures of a JSIM model.
    NetStrategies.ServiceStrategies
    Service time strategies determining the service time of jobs at a station, including load independent and load dependent service distributions.
    NetStrategies.TransitionUtilities
    Utility classes for the transitions of the place-transition structures supported by the JSIM simulation engine.
    NetStrategies.VacationStrategies
    Vacation strategies modelling servers that suspend their service for a vacation period, as supported by the extended JSIM simulation engine.
    NodeSections
    Node sections, the building blocks from which the JSIM simulation engine stations are composed.
    QueueNet
    Queueing network model of the JSIM simulation engine: nodes, stations, jobs, job classes, measures and the global structures that connect them.
    random
    Random number generation for the JSIM simulation engine.
    random.discrete
    Discrete probability distributions for the JSIM simulation engine (Bernoulli, binomial, geometric, Poisson, uniform, ...).
    random.engine
    Random number generator engines (including the Mersenne Twister) underlying the JMT distribution classes.
    simDispatcher
    Dispatcher that schedules and coordinates simulation jobs, including the parallel execution of the simulations required by what-if analyses.
    simEngine
    Core of the JSIM discrete event simulation engine: the simulation system, entities, events, predicates and event queues on which all JMT simulation tools rely.
    simEngine.xml
    XML input support of the JSIM simulation engine, used to load and configure the engine from model files.
    solvers
    Solution algorithms of JMVA.
    solvers.basis
    Basis representations of the MoM and CoMoM exact solution algorithms of JMVA.
    solvers.basis.comparators
    Comparators used to order the basis vectors of the MoM and CoMoM algorithms.
    solvers.control
    Control logic of the JMVA solvers.
    solvers.dataStructures
    Data structures shared by the JMVA solvers (tuples, positions, lists and matrices).
    solvers.dispatchers
    Solver dispatchers of JMVA, which select and drive the appropriate exact or approximate solution algorithm for the model under study.
    solvers.dispatchers.wrappers
    Wrapper solvers used by the JMVA dispatchers.
    solvers.exceptions
    Exceptions raised by the JMVA solvers (internal errors, BTF matrix errors, inconsistent linear systems).
    solvers.linearSystem
    Linear system formulation shared by the MoM and CoMoM exact algorithms of JMVA.
    solvers.linearSystem.btf
    Block Triangular Form (BTF) of the linear systems arising in the MoM and CoMoM algorithms, as described in the method of moments literature.
    solvers.linearSystem.btf.macroBlocks
    Macro blocks of the Block Triangular Form linear system decomposition used by the JMVA MoM and CoMoM solvers.
    solvers.linearSystem.btf.microBlocks
    Micro blocks of the Block Triangular Form linear system decomposition used by the JMVA MoM and CoMoM solvers.
    solvers.linearSystem.btf.topLevelBlocks
    Top level blocks of the Block Triangular Form linear system decomposition used by the JMVA MoM and CoMoM solvers.
    solvers.linearSystem.simple
    Simple linear system solvers used by JMVA.
    solvers.linearSystem.simple.matrix
    Matrix implementation of the simple linear system solvers used by JMVA.
    solvers.linearSystemSolver
    Linear system solver used by the exact JMVA solution algorithms.
    solvers.multiSolverAlgorithms
    Multiclass solution algorithms of JMVA: exact MVA, RECAL, MoM, CoMoM, TreeMVA and TreeConvolution for closed multiclass models, together with their approximate variants.
    solvers.priority
    Priority support of the JMVA solvers: Priority MVA (P-MVA) and Related Workload Approximation (RWA) calculators for models with priority classes.
    solvers.priority.interpolators
    Interpolators of the JMVA priority MVA calculators.
    solvers.priority.prioMVACalculators
    Priority MVA (P-MVA) calculators of JMVA for queueing networks with priority classes.
    solvers.priority.prioMVACalculators.implementations
    Implementations of the JMVA priority MVA calculators.
    solvers.priority.prioMVACalculators.implementations.utilisations
    Utilization submodels of the JMVA priority MVA calculator implementations.
    solvers.priority.rwaCalculators
    Related Workload Approximation (RWA) calculators of JMVA for queueing networks with priority classes.
    solvers.priority.rwaCalculators.implementations
    Implementations of the JMVA Related Workload Approximation calculators.
    solvers.queueingnet
    Queueing network model of JMVA: stations, classes, service demands and visits used by the exact and approximate solution algorithms.
    solvers.queueingnet.amva
    Approximate MVA (AMVA) algorithms of JMVA for closed networks: Chow, Bard-Schweitzer, Linearizer, DeSouza-Muntz Linearizer and AQL (Aggregate Queue Length), as described in the JMVA chapter of the user manual.
    solvers.queueingnet.montecarloLogistic
    Monte Carlo logistic regression used by the exact JMVA algorithms when the model dimension grows (logistic approximation of normalizing constants).
    solvers.queueingnet.montecarloLogistic.distributions
    Probability distributions used by the JMVA Monte Carlo logistic regression.
    solvers.queueingnet.montecarloLogistic.numericalIntegration
    Numerical integration used by the JMVA Monte Carlo logistic regression.
    solvers.queueingnet.montecarloLogistic.solver
    Monte Carlo logistic solvers of JMVA.
    solvers.queueingnet.treeAlgorithms
    Tree based exact algorithms of JMVA: TreeMVA and TreeConvolution, which reduce the complexity of the exact solution of large closed models.
    solvers.queueingnet.treeAlgorithms.tmva
    TreeMVA algorithm of JMVA, the tree based version of the exact Mean Value Analysis.
    solvers.queueingnet.treeAlgorithms.treeConvolution
    TreeConvolution algorithm of JMVA, the tree based version of the convolution algorithm.
    solvers.singleSolverAlgorithms
    Single class solution algorithms of JMVA: exact MVA, stabilized exact MVA for load dependent stations, open model solution and related single class solvers.
    solvers.utilities
    Utilities of the JMVA solvers, such as the processing capacity checker used to verify that the workload can be processed by the network.
    table
    Enhanced JTable implementations used across the JMT GUI tools (clipboard support, click aware headers, ...).
